title: Reflexive bounded walks
statement: For every relation $E$ on $\mathbb{N}$ and all $n,j,c\in\mathbb{N}$, there is a walk from $c$ to itself of length at most $j$, where a walk of length at most zero means equality and a walk at a positive bound means either equality or an initial step to some $v<n$ following $E$, followed by a walk with bound one less.
